name: MUSTARDSAUCE
description: MUSTARDSAUCE is a theorem-and-proof benchmark containing 5,866 validated data points synthesized via the MUSTARD framework. Each data point includes informal statements, informal proofs, and formal proofs verified by a proof assistant, designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical reasoning and theorem proving.
reputation: A specialized theorem-proving benchmark that is newer and less widely adopted than long-running math benchmarks, but notable for verified formal proofs and curated data.
notes: Data synthesized with generative models and validated by proof assistants; enables fine-tuning for improved theorem proving.
